gate_assessment.statement: At the VAL-chosen 1% tau the combined engine flags 0.0100 of VAL clean days but 0.0492 of TEST clean days. 91% of the TEST false flags (496 of 545) come from the two Nepal stations, which hold 51% of the TEST clean days and are the only TEST stations outside the training distribution of Indian stations; without them the TEST rate is 0.0089. The threshold does not transfer to those stations: the engine is NOT at 1% on TEST, so the full-engine recalls below are at a higher false-flag rate than the baselines (read the oracle-matched rows and the model-score rows for matched-rate comparisons).
